name: ze_Pt8_MWW
title: Pt8 @ MWW
description: Pt8 cluster in the 12-ring supercage (7.1 x 18.2 A, 10-ring windows) of a frozen all-silica MWW (MCM-22/ITQ-1) framework (NEP89-relaxed hexagonal cell, 216 atoms); subnanometric Pt clusters encapsulated in MCM-22 cavities are sinter-resistant, size-selective catalysts (Liu et al., Nat. Mater. 16, 132 (2017)). Framework Al/H+ sites and framework relaxation are absent, NEP89 places this framework 0.8 kJ/mol SiO2 below alpha-quartz and attracts Pt to the cage wall by ~0.7 eV/atom even at Pt-O distances > 3 A, so the global minimum is a model-PES optimum.
